title: Build AI Workflows With Guardrails, Not One Super-Agent
description:
AI automation shouldn’t mean letting AI do whatever it wants.

We give each bot one job, set a clear definition of success, add a safety bar, and keep a human verifier in the loop before anything important gets shipped.

That makes it much easier to scale without letting one bad workflow create a much bigger problem.
